g.text: Preferred screenshot selections first · one strip per figure · cool or neutral structure with sparse accents
Default rigorous blue-gray figure with one clear red highlight
Dark teal structure with warm comparison, risk, or transition states
Restrained green-gray process, observer, or industrial-system diagram
Environmental, biological, energy, or condition-monitoring figure with red contrast
Fully cool architecture, layered hierarchy, or multi-series plot
Cross-domain framework or balanced method comparison
Dark-blue foundation with red-to-yellow severity or stage progression
Muted grouping regions, background panels, or a soft conceptual overview
High-contrast conceptual mechanism; keep lime accents sparse
Cool blue-green feedback, estimation, sensing, or closed-loop diagram
Multi-category comparison or cross-domain framework with a dark teal anchor
Fault, alarm, unsafe-state, or before–after comparison
Architecture or workflow figure needing yellow or orange emphasis
Conservative theorem, observer, or control-flow diagram without a vivid warning color
Ordered severity, diagnostic classes, or ablation emphasis with a dark berry anchor
Soft conceptual grouping or multi-panel background; use dark neutral text and outlines
Vivid categorical comparison or benchmark overview; avoid using every swatch as an equal accent
Muted lifecycle, materials, health, or cross-domain grouping with a charcoal anchor
Multi-stage system or multi-series plot; normally use only four to six swatches
Minimal high-contrast diagram with a single gold innovation marker

svg.text: Hex codes and semantic role mappings are authoritative in references/scientific-figure-palettes.md.
